newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Group forms for Korea Long $100 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Group forms for Korea Long $100 mln FRN.

text.p: A group has formed for Korea Long Term Credit Bank's US$100 million floating rate note issue, the joint lead managers said on Tuesday.
Sakura Finance Asia and ABN Amro Hoare Govett are the joint leads.
The issue is now free to trade.
The facility has a final maturity of 364 days. It was priced at par to float at 35 basis points over the three-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are eight basis points split as three basis points for management and underwriting and five basis points for selling.

BA Asia, Banque Nationale de Paris, Chase Manhattan Asia, DKB Asia, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, ING Barings, Lehman Brothers, Merrill Lynch Far East, Standard Chartered Bank and WestLB are co-lead managers.
